title: Carriers CRUD API with onboarding status and insurance warnings
description: Implement full CRUD for carriers: create, list (paginated with filters), update, soft-delete. Add onboarding status endpoint that consumes foundation's checkCarrierOnboarding utility. Include insurance expiry warning logic (30-day and 7-day thresholds). Enforce delete constraint: cannot deactivate carrier with active loads. All endpoints scoped to org via auth middleware. Note: dispatch-api service key not yet in packages.json — depends on foundation BE-001 creating the API package. CONCERNS.md flags that dispatch-api has no lint command — validationCommand excludes lint.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/carriers returns 201 with carrier data including generated UUID id
POST validates required fields: name, type; rejects OWNER_OPERATOR type with 400 and message 'Owner-operator support coming soon'

POST accepts all Carrier model fields: name, type, mcNumber, dotNumber, ein, phone, email, address, city, state, zip, dispatchFeePercent (default 10), partnerSplitPercent (default 50), feeIncludesAccessorials (default false), onboarding booleans, notes
GET /api/v1/carriers returns paginated list with default limit 25, max 100, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasMore }
GET supports ?type= filter (COMPANY_ASSET, EXTERNAL_CARRIER), ?search= (matches name, mcNumber), ?sort=&order= (default createdAt desc)

List response includes computed fields per carrier: driverCount (integer), vehicleCount (integer), onboardingComplete (boolean — true when all 3 required onboarding booleans are true and insurance not expired)
Carriers with insuranceExpiry within 30 days include insuranceWarning: '30_DAY' or '7_DAY' or 'EXPIRED' field in response
PATCH /api/v1/carriers/:id returns 200 with updated carrier; validates same rules as POST
Soft delete via DELETE /api/v1/carriers/:id sets deletedAt; returns 409 ConflictError with list of blocking load IDs if carrier has loads with status before PAID
GET /api/v1/carriers/:id/onboarding returns { allowed: boolean, missingDocuments: string[] } using foundation's checkCarrierOnboarding utility
All list queries filter WHERE deletedAt IS NULL
All endpoints require auth middleware; carrier scoped to managedByOrgId matching authenticated user's orgId
DISPATCHER users do not see partnerSplitPercent in responses (per PRD role matrix)
Yup validation schemas defined for CreateCarrierInput and UpdateCarrierInput
Entity IDs use uuid format (per cross-feature decision L-009)
contractReference: paths./carriers, paths./carriers/{carrierId}, paths./carriers/{carrierId}/onboarding, components/schemas/Carrier, components/schemas/CarrierListItem, components/schemas/OnboardingStatus
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
decisions: Added ActiveLoadsConflictError to shared/errors.ts with blockingLoadIds field; updated errorHandler to emit structured blockingLoadIds array for 409 delete conflict responses per API contract ConflictErrorBody schema
